changelog:
v2.2.1 — Content Info Overlay D-pad Fix

• Fixed D-pad navigation in long-press info overlay (Play/Favorite/Trailer buttons now navigable)
• Back key properly dismisses info overlay instead of exiting the screen
• Focus trapped within overlay — D-pad can no longer escape to grid behind
• Removed focusableInTouchMode from overlay buttons (TV best practice)
• Fixed overlay memory leak on fragment destroy
